text:
Rina: Coordination thread for RiverCity meetup next month. Need to confirm: 1) bench narrative we present at the meetup, 2) swag pick list (table tents vs hoodies), 3) walk-in demo flow and speaker handoff. Doc: https://docs.google.com/rivercity.

Marc: For the bench narrative, keep it simple: "median latency vs baseline" and "cost per 1k tokens". We'll include a small callout about routing policies. I'll mock visuals.

Ava: Speaker handoff plan: 5-min opener (Ava), 10-min deep-dive (Marc), 10-min live demo (Priya), 5-min Q&A (Rina). Need transitions and cue cards.

Priya: Will prepare a 3-step live demo script and a minimal repo for attendees. Also will prepare a fallback demo recording if network is flaky.

Nora: Swag options: we have budget for 120 items. Recommend 60 stickers, 30 socks, 30 branded notebooks. T-shirts are tight in budget. Delivery ETA Tue before event.

Zoe: Inbound routing: small form on iPad for business cards + QR for deeper interest. HubSpot tagging: rivercity2026_meetup. SDR follow-up SLA 48h.

Marc: Need final infra numbers to avoid overstating results. Please send confirmed metrics by EOD tomorrow.

Rina: I'll book the AV and request a mic and HDMI. Also request 2 chairs near the demo table for panelists.

Ava: Action items: Marc finalize visuals, Priya demo script + fallback video, Nora confirm swag ETA, Zoe HubSpot tags, Rina AV booking. Freeze assets in 72h. ops-bot: set reminder.

ops-bot: Reminder set 72 hours until asset freeze.
